_meta.title: Cell and axis record schema for the reduced-activity mechanism table
_meta.note: Scoring code must validate every record against this schema before it is written. A record that cannot be expressed in this schema is not scored; it is logged as a schema gap.

axis_record.units: string or null — e.g. 'percent of wake baseline', 'ml O2/g/h'
axis_record.baseline: string — what the comparison baseline was, in the source's terms
axis_record.evidence_grade: enum: E-A | E-B | E-C | E-D | E-E | E-F
citation_ids: string — keys into citations/ledger.json, all verified

cell_record._status_rule: POSITIVE requires coverage TESTED_POSITIVE and strongest_grade in {E-A,E-B,E-C,E-D}. If coverage is TESTED_POSITIVE but strongest_grade is E-E or E-F, status is SUGGESTED. NEGATIVE requires coverage TESTED_NEGATIVE and a negative_assay_statement. Otherwise NOT_TESTED.
cell_record.strongest_grade: enum: E-A | E-B | E-C | E-D | E-E | E-F | null
all_grades: enum values present among the supporting evidence
cell_record.negative_assay_statement: string or null — what the assay could have detected, required when coverage is TESTED_NEGATIVE

mechanism_record.label: string — short name of the mechanism as documented

chain.step: string — the causal step in the source's own terms
chain.inferred: boolean — true if this step has no direct evidence in THIS (row_id); inferred steps score no cell
chain.evidence_grade: enum or null — null iff inferred is true

mechanism_record.proximal_class: integer 1-11 — most membrane/metabolism-proximal step with direct evidence in this row

molecules.name: string
molecules.species: string — must equal the row's species
molecules.identifier: string — WormBase ID, HGNC, UniProt, as available
molecules.ortholog_relation: string or null — named and sourced; never used to score a cell

row_summary.coverage_denominator: integer 0-11 — count of classes with coverage != NOT_TESTED
row_summary._reporting_rule: Every proportion derived from this row is reported over coverage_denominator, never over 11.

citation_record._note: Mirrors the earlier dauer-gate citation harness (eutils title fetch; reimplemented in scoring/lit.py). No cell may reference a citation_id absent from the verified ledger.
citation_record.title_matches_claim: boolean — set by a human or by title-content verification, not by resolution alone

forbidden_operations: any count or proportion reported against 11 rather than coverage_denominator
any aggregation of A_beh, A_neu, A_met into a single value
scoring a cell from an inferred chain step
scoring a cell from literature co-occurrence
treating NOT_TESTED as NEGATIVE in any output
